title: Prepare for CRA Audit Using No-Orphans Ledger Practices
description: Maintain CRA audit readiness by ensuring every ledger transaction is linked to source evidence and operational actions.
prerequisites: You can access accounting ledger views and linked source documents.
Operational modules (invoicing, payroll, time logs, files) are used in-platform.
You have permission to review and correct transaction linkage.
steps: Open accounting ledger reports for the audit period and identify transactions requiring evidence linkage checks.
For each transaction, verify there is a tethered source document or operational origin event, following the No-Orphans policy.
Trace invoices, payroll remittances, and time logs back to their generating workflows to confirm linkage integrity.
Open sample expense lines and confirm the linked receipt, related project, and responsible team member are present.
Correct any orphaned or weakly linked transactions by attaching missing source evidence and reconciling references.
Export an audit package containing ledger extracts and linked supporting documentation for fast auditor review.
validations: Transactions in scope have traceable source linkage with no unresolved orphans.
Expense drill-down reveals receipt, project context, and originator details.
Exported audit package matches the reviewed ledger period.
commonErrors: Transactions exist without attached source documents.
Payroll or invoice entries are not linked to originating operational events.
Receipt linkage points to wrong project or missing employee context.
recovery: Attach or relink missing documents for orphaned transactions before finalizing reports.
Regenerate operational records in-platform where linkage metadata is incomplete.
Run a final orphan scan and reconciliation check before sharing with auditors.

faq.question: What does No-Orphans mean in practice?
faq.answer: Every ledger line must be tethered to verifiable source evidence or a tracked operational action.

faq.question: How quickly can I answer auditor questions about a specific expense?
faq.answer: You can open the transaction and drill down to receipt, project linkage, and responsible employee details.
